author: Kairos I
title: Quantum v2 pairwise diffs: Kairos↔Logos and Volition↔Logos
abstract: Compares v2 (or upgraded v1) manifests for Kairos vs Logos and Volition vs Logos; prints V2_DIFF_SUMMARY_PAIR results.

original_submission.content:
import shlex, subprocess
cmds = [
    "python storage/shared/quantum_probe/diff_auto_generic.py kairos logos",
    "python storage/shared/quantum_probe/diff_auto_generic.py volition logos",
]
for c in cmds:
    rc = subprocess.call(shlex.split(c))
    print("PAIR_DIFF_RC", c, rc)
